summary: Klamath County ground-level 6x6 cab built 1930, abandoned by 1950 and collapsed; no source describes the site today or whether it is open to visitors.

notes_for_editor: Elevation conflict: register 2,855 ft (870 m, matches brief's 870.2 m) vs firelookout.com 5149 ft; not resolved, and elevation is not in the facts schema.
